rule: No file bytes leave the device: decoding and transcription run in the tab; the page makes no third-party requests.
evidence: Observed: zero external requests during a full run (2026-11-01).

rule: No artificial file-size limit. The app preflights navigator.deviceMemory and attempts the file; if the tab runs out of memory it fails with an actionable message naming the limit it hit.
evidence: Owner decision 2026-11-01: client-side work does not stress the server.

rule: Audio is transcribed in 30-second chunks with a 3-second overlap; overlapping words are removed when chunks are merged.

While a run is active the app names the current stage and shows progress measured from work done: during the model download, bytes loaded over bytes total; during transcription, chunk n of m and the percentage derived from completed chunks, with the time elapsed. Partial text appears as each chunk completes. No estimated time remaining is shown (PRAC-9: a percentage only when measured, otherwise elapsed time).
evidence: Owner decision 2026-11-01 after a blank-screen report.
notes: Aligned to PRAC-9 on 2026-11-01; the earlier "remaining" promise was not licensed by the practice.

rule: Model and runtime assets are stored in browser Cache Storage and reused across visits; a refresh does not re-download them.
evidence: Observed: repeat load had transferSize 0 for tokenizer.

rule: The document is: H1 title (source name), a blockquote with duration/model/language, an H2 Transcript, then either timestamped paragraphs or one paragraph.
When the browser cannot decode the audio natively, ffmpeg.wasm is used to extract 16 kHz mono audio before transcription.
evidence: Verified 2026-11-01: AVI (mpeg4/mp3) decoded via ffmpeg.wasm and transcribed correctly. Two defects found and fixed first: the worker URL, and a 48 kHz decode feeding Whisper.

rule: Every failure names what failed and what to try next; no bare "something went wrong".

The page follows the operating-system light or dark preference by default. A visible control lets the visitor switch themes; the choice persists in localStorage and overrides the system setting. Both themes meet 4.5:1 body-text contrast.
